title: Close Web Browser
text:
Breadcrumbs
The
Close Web Browser
building block closes one browser window or all open browser windows. This block only works with browser windows that were previously opened using the
Start Web Browser
block (or their child windows).
Fully expanded, the
Close Web Browser
block shows the following properties:
Note:
The screenshot on this page uses the
Elegance Design

2025.3
. If you are using an earlier version, your layout may look different.
Quick-start
Drag
Close Web Browser
onto the canvas.
Connect the block in the flow and optionally specify
Close all
or
Browser window
.
Run the flow when it’s ready.
Building block parameters
Parameters
Block header
: The green input connector triggers the block to start executing. The green output connector triggers when the browser window(s) have been closed. You can rename the block title (“Close Web Browser”) by double-clicking it and typing a new title.
Close all
: When selected, the block closes all open browser windows.
Browser window
: Makes the block close a specific browser window. Multiple browser windows are not supported by Selenium Grid or external cloud providers such as
Sauce Labs
and
BrowserStack
.
